_comment: MISSION P3-b: pinned OpenCode server integrated as a local child process (127.0.0.1, driven by the extension over HTTP). The packager downloads the asset below, verifies size+sha256, and places the binary at sudo-ai-extension/bin/opencode[.exe]. No OpenCode binary is committed to git.
name: opencode
sourceRepoNote: github.com/sst/opencode currently redirects to github.com/anomalyco/opencode; release assets below are used verbatim.
licenseAudit: 810-node runtime closure from bun.lock (tag v1.19.0) + npm registry: 0 copyleft, 0 unknown (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Method documented there (license-checker equivalent; opencode installs with bun, not npm).

server.protocol: HTTP + SSE on 127.0.0.1 only, basic auth via random OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD per spawn

windows-x64.sha256: COMPUTE-AT-PACKAGING (download, verify size, record sha256 here)

binaryResolution: env SUDO_OPENCODE_BIN (explicit path, used by tests)
